headlines.description: Teenage winger Rio Ngumoha announced himself to the Champions League as Liverpool extended their 100% record the hard way as they came from two goals down to beat Villarreal 4-3.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mac Allister, Ngumoha lead Liverpool rally to stay perfect in UCL

headlines.description: Phil Foden scored a hat trick as Manchester City got their Champions League campaign back on track with an emphatic 5-1 win over AEK Athens.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foden hat trick fuels emphatic Man City win as Haaland rested

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain overcame injuries to three key players to end Barcelona's 11-game winning streak with a 4-2 Champions League victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG hand Barcelona first loss of season in Champions League thriller
